notes.title: Achievement & Translation Update
notes.content:
Hi, everyone. As we're constantly working on improving the game, this time we decided to focus on achievements, translation and some controls. Here's what we came up with:


 Now with a full set of Steam achievements
 Improved keyboard controls
 Serbian and Slovak translation added
 Overall game experience improved to be more intuitive and straight forward


We love hearing from you, so please send all your feedback to support@peaksel.email .
